regions.name: Northern areas
regions.where: Northern Nigeria: all North-West and North-East states plus the North-Central states (Niger, Kwara, Kogi, Benue, Plateau, Nasarawa, FCT) (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Rainy shading starts mid-Apr. Main planting mid-May to mid-Jul. Lean box ends and main harvest starts mid-Sep. Off-season planting is the Dec 'Off-Ssn' bar plus an unlabelled Jan bar (one span). Off-season harvest Apr-May has no rainy season on the image.

regions.name: Southern areas
regions.where: Southern Nigeria: the South-West, South-South and South-East states (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Rainy shading mid-Feb to end Nov (one block only). Planting mid-Feb to end Apr. Main harvest mid-Sep to mid-Dec. Lean box mid-May to mid-Aug. Green harvest of maize and yams (teal, mid-May to mid-Sep) excluded. Cassava harvest bar runs all year.

assign.method: Matched the purple locator maps, whose north/south boundary follows state lines (19 northern states + FCT vs the 17 southern states); transition states set to medium.

transcriber_notes: Convention: this template snaps edges to whole or half months; an edge at mid-month is treated as covering half of that month and so the month is included (schema rule 'at least half'). Southern areas show a single rainy-season block although the south is usually described as bimodal; transcribed as drawn. Several edges sit exactly at mid-month (rainy start mid-Apr north / mid-Feb south, lean ends mid-Sep north / mid-Aug south, south lean starts mid-May, south main harvest ends mid-Dec).
